items.title: The Gysin maps attached to two Cartier divisors commute
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma says that the two Gysin maps associated with two Cartier divisor triples on X commute, so that the square CH_k(X) -> CH_{k-1}(D) -> CH_{k-2}(D intersect D') agrees with the other way round (statement lines 5495-5508, tag 0B73). The proof reduces to a single integral class, chooses meromorphic sections normalised to agree with the canonical sections away from the divisors, writes both composites as cycles built from the same local generators at the generic points, and then invokes the key formula so that the difference becomes a sum of divisors of tame symbols that vanishes term by term away from the intersection. The local bookkeeping and the passage from [W] to arbitrary cycles are the substance, so the claim is H2.
